name: draco tera compact 16-port KVM matrix (Cat X, discontinued)
source: IHSE draco tera compact manual (480 series)
notes: 16 Cat X I/O ports on the front in 1 group of 16, serial and network RJ45 on the front; standard and redundant power inlets and a ground stud on the back. IHSE has replaced the 16 to 80 port compact models with draco tera flex; the 8-port compact stays as an entry-level model. Ports are IHSE KVM links: Cat X (RJ45, up to 140 m, 100 m for 3G) or fibre (LC, multi-mode up to 1 km, single-mode up to 10 km). They are not Ethernet: patch them straight to the extenders, never through a network switch. Any port can take a CPU unit (computer) or a CON unit (console). Check: 1RU height and the power inlet type (the manual does not say).

name: draco tera flex 16-port KVM matrix (Cat X)
source: IHSE draco tera flex datasheet and manual
notes: 1RU, 44 x 442 x 449 mm (H x W x D), about 7.7 kg. Front: I/O ports in groups of 8, 2 x RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet (redundant network) and a reset button. Back: two switched IEC C14 inlets, standard and redundant (dual integrated supplies, 100-240 V 3 A), and a ground stud. Mounting brackets included. Built from 8-port I/O boards (F480-C8 Cat X, F480-CX8 Cat X 3G, F480-F8 fibre, F480-FX8 fibre 3G), so boards can be swapped later. Ports are IHSE KVM links: Cat X (RJ45, up to 140 m, 100 m for 3G) or fibre (LC, multi-mode up to 1 km, single-mode up to 10 km). They are not Ethernet: patch them straight to the extenders, never through a network switch. Any port can take a CPU unit (computer) or a CON unit (console).

name: draco SIRA CPU module (Cat X 1G)
source: IHSE draco SIRA CPU datasheet
notes: Thin client and KVM transmitter in one draco vario module: it opens remote sessions (RDP, RemoteFX, SSH, VNC, HTML5 kiosk) over its network port and sends them into the draco matrix or to a CON unit over its link port. USB 2.0 and 2-channel audio are embedded. Draws 3.0-3.5 A at 5 V from the chassis, so it needs a ventilated chassis (one with a backplane such as 474-BODY6BPF, or a 474-MODFAN fan). 129 x 40 x 145 mm, 300 g: twice the 20 mm thickness of a normal module, so it takes two slots (in a 1RU chassis, both rows of one column: start it in an odd slot). Invoice part number L488-BIPC-R1 is revision 1 of L488-BIPC.
